outcome: Imaging morphology and distribution of birth-related SDH
Relationship of birth-related SDH with mode of delivery and birth weight
cohort: 148 infants up to 1 month old who had a CT or MRI of the brain
finding: Birth-related subdural hemorrhage (SDH) is common, with a prevalence of 37.8%, and is significantly more common after vaginal delivery compared to cesarean section.
mod_finding: The rate of birth-related SDH was significantly higher in the vaginal delivery group compared to the caesarean section group.
birth_weight: No statistically significant difference in birth weight between infants with and without birth-related SDH
